title: Pay by QR
scan_hint: Scan the code in any Kyrgyz bank app
step_2: Choose "Pay by QR" and point the camera at the code
no_apps_hint: Save the QR code and open it in your bank app: "Pay by QR" → "From gallery". Or open the page with all banks.
app_not_opened: App did not open? Save the QR code and pay with your bank's scanner, or pick another bank.
inapp_hint: You opened the site inside another app — bank buttons may not work here. Open the payment page in your browser or copy the link.
open_in_browser: Open the payment page in your browser
save_hint: A saved QR can be loaded in your bank app from the gallery or downloads.
save_failed: Could not save automatically. Open the image and save it with a long press.
cancel_busy: Your bank is already processing a payment for this QR. Checking — please wait a few seconds.
auto_note: Credits are added automatically right after payment. You can close this window — the payment is kept.
connection_retry: No connection to the server, retrying…
processing_note: Crediting your account — usually under a minute. If credits do not appear, contact support with the order number.
expired_note: If you have already paid, credits will be added automatically. Otherwise create a new QR code.
failed_note: The bank declined the payment. Create a new QR code or choose another method.
not_found: QR code not found — it may already be closed. Create a new one.
test_badge: TEST PAYMENT. This QR is not payable; the status changes by itself in about 20 seconds.
test_no_qr: Test payment: GoPay sent no QR code. The status will change by itself.
err_too_often: Too many attempts — wait a minute and try again.
err_busy: We are checking your previous QR payment — try again in a few seconds.
err_too_many: Too many open QR codes. Wait a few minutes and try again.
err_unavailable: QR payment is unavailable right now. Try later or choose another method.
err_discount_held: The discount is attached to another started payment. Go back to the method choice.
pending_title: You have an unfinished QR payment
